name: Lat pulldown
hint: Overhead cable and long bar above a seat with a thigh pad
visual: a lat pulldown exercise machine, with a high overhead cable, wide pulldown bar, compact seat and thigh pads
steps: Adjust the thigh pad so it holds your thighs securely. Put both feet flat and choose an easy load.
Grip the bar and sit tall. Draw your elbows down and bring the bar toward your upper chest.
Let the bar rise under control. Avoid swinging or pulling behind your neck.

name: 45° leg press
hint: Reclined seat and large footplate on angled rails
visual: a 45 degree inclined plate loaded leg press exercise machine with a large footplate on diagonal sled rails, a low reclined seat and weight plates
steps: Check the safety stops and practise operating the catches with a light load. Place both feet flat on the platform.
Keep your back and hips against the pad as you lower the platform. Let your knees follow your toes.
Push through your whole foot, keeping a slight bend at the top. Secure both catches before stepping away.

name: Seated cable row
hint: Low cable, horizontal seat or bench, and footrests
visual: a seated low cable row exercise machine with a horizontal bench, footplates, and a low front pulley handle
steps: Place your feet on the footrests and adjust the seat if possible. Take the handle with your arms extended and knees softly bent.
Keep your torso steady and pull the handle toward your lower ribs. Let your elbows travel back close to your sides.
Return the handle slowly. Avoid jerking the cable or leaning back to finish the pull.

name: Leg extension
hint: Upright seat with a padded roller in front of the ankles
visual: a seated leg extension exercise machine with an upright padded chair and a shin roller for lifting the lower legs
steps: Adjust the backrest so your knees line up with the machine's pivot. Position the roller just above your ankles.
Sit back against the seat and straighten your knees through a comfortable range with a light load.
Lower slowly and keep your hips against the seat. Avoid kicking the weight up.
